topic.title: Quantum Learning, Optimization, and Adaptive Control
topic.area: Molecular, Biological, and Quantum Machine Learning
topic.overview: This topic examines learning algorithms involving quantum states, parameterized circuits, and quantum hardware control. Papers study encoding limits, statistical behavior, optimization, and hybrid classical–quantum methods. A representative approach learns an approximate linear description of optimization dynamics through Koopman methods, using it to reduce repeated gradient computation during quantum optimization.
topic.whyItMatters: Quantum learning must account for measurement cost, noise, and device variation as well as model expressivity. Claimed algorithmic savings are most informative when compared with the cost of collecting quantum information and maintaining a calibrated device.
topic.evolution: The representatives include early quantum networks and clustering, followed by classifier algorithms and analyses of parameterized circuits. Recent work develops equilibrium or adaptive architectures and studies when task-specific adaptation improves quantum control enough to justify recalibration overhead.
openQuestions: Which learning advantages survive realistic measurement and hardware noise?
How can adaptation budgets be selected before committing substantial device time to a new control task?

papers.title: Quantum Perceptron Models

papers.tldr: Quantum algorithms train constant-margin classifiers with square-root dependence on sample count and dimension, with a nearly matching lower bound.

papers.title: q-means: A quantum algorithm for unsupervised machine learning
papers.tldr: Q-means offers quantum clustering with an exponential speedup in dataset size and guarantees similar to robust k-means.

papers.title: Quantum Entropy Scoring for Fast Robust Mean Estimation and Improved Outlier Detection

papers.title: Quantum Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks

papers.title: Quantum Boosting

papers.title: The Hintons in your Neural Network: a Quantum Field Theory View of Deep Learning

papers.title: Parametrized Quantum Policies for Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Reinforcement learning for optimization of variational quantum circuit architectures

papers.title: The Inductive Bias of Quantum Kernels

papers.title: Equivariant Quantum Graph Circuits

papers.title: Optimizing Tensor Network Contraction Using Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Algorithms from Randomized Numerical Linear Algebra

papers.title: Concentration of Data Encoding in Parameterized Quantum Circuits

papers.title: Differentiable Analog Quantum Computing for Optimization and Control

papers.title: Escaping from the Barren Plateau via Gaussian Initializations in Deep Variational Quantum Circuits
papers.tldr: Proper Gaussian initialization provably prevents gradient norms from decaying faster than polynomially as quantum circuits become deeper and contain more qubits.

papers.title: GraphQNTK: Quantum Neural Tangent Kernel for Graph Data

papers.title: Power and limitations of single-qubit native quantum neural networks

papers.title: Quantum Algorithms for Sampling Log-Concave Distributions and Estimating Normalizing Constants
papers.tldr: Quantum sampling and integration algorithms improve query complexity for log-concave distributions, with nearly optimal accuracy dependence for normalising constants.

papers.title: Quantum Speedups of Optimizing Approximately Convex Functions with Applications to Logarithmic Regret Stochastic Convex Bandits
papers.tldr: Quantum algorithms speed up approximately convex optimization and achieve polylogarithmic-in-time regret for the studied stochastic convex bandit setting.

papers.title: SALSA: Attacking Lattice Cryptography with Transformers

papers.title: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approach based on the Hadamard Transform for the Convolutional Layer
papers.tldr: A Hadamard-transform neural layer supports quantum implementation and improves reported image classification accuracy while reducing computation.

papers.title: Analyzing Convergence in Quantum Neural Networks: Deviations from Neural Tangent Kernels

papers.title: Efficient Quantum Algorithms for Quantum Optimal Control

papers.title: Q-Flow: Generative Modeling for Differential Equations of Open Quantum Dynamics with Normalizing Flows

papers.title: QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architecture Search and A Benchmark

papers.title: Quantum Ridgelet Transform: Winning Lottery Ticket of Neural Networks with Quantum Computation

papers.title: Quantum Speedups for Zero-Sum Games via Improved Dynamic Gibbs Sampling

papers.title: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms

papers.title: Towards Quantum Machine Learning for Constrained Combinatorial Optimization: a Quantum QAP Solver

papers.title: ANTN: Bridging Autoregressive Neural Networks and Tensor Networks for Quantum Many-Body Simulation
papers.tldr: ANTN combines tensor networks and autoregressive neural networks to represent quantum states with exact sampling and improved empirical simulation performance.

papers.title: Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits: Parallel Environments and Benchmark

papers.title: Quantum speedups for stochastic optimization

papers.title: Statistical Analysis of Quantum State Learning Process in Quantum Neural Networks

papers.title: Wasserstein Quantum Monte Carlo: A Novel Approach for Solving the Quantum Many-Body Schrödinger Equation
papers.tldr: Wasserstein Quantum Monte Carlo optimizes Born distributions through probability transport and empirically converges faster on molecular ground-state problems.

papers.title: What Makes Data Suitable for a Locally Connected Neural Network? A Necessary and Sufficient Condition Based on Quantum Entanglement.

papers.title: Adaptive Observation Cost Control for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers

papers.title: Deep Stochastic Mechanics

papers.title: QBMK: Quantum-based Matching Kernels for Un-attributed Graphs

papers.tldr: Richer quantum kernels may reveal useful structural dependencies and create opportunities that scalar-valued kernels leave unexplored.

papers.tldr: The paper argues for incorporating quantum validity constraints into program generation rather than relying on scaling and post-generation filtering.

papers.tldr: SAQNN is a constructive quantum neural network with universal approximation and provable resource advantages in specified function-approximation settings.
